mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_text (work_id, field, lang, kind, text, source, model) VALUES (#{t.workId}, #{t.field}, #{t.lang}, #{t.kind}, #{t.text}, #{t.source}, #{t.model}) ON CONFLICT (work_id, field, lang, kind) DO UPDATE SET text = EXCLUDED.text, source = EXCLUDED.source, model = EXCLUDED.model

INSERT INTO work_text (work_id, field, lang, kind, text, source, model) VALUES (#{t.workId}, #{t.field}, #{t.lang}, #{t.kind}, #{t.text}, #{t.source}, #{t.model}) ON CONFLICT (work_id, field, lang, kind) DO UPDATE SET text = EXCLUDED.text, source = EXCLUDED.source, model = EXCLUDED.model WHERE (CASE work_text.source WHEN 'CROSSREF' THEN 0 WHEN 'OPENALEX' THEN 1 WHEN 'EUROPEPMC' THEN 2 WHEN 'OAI' THEN 3 WHEN 'MAGTECH' THEN 3 WHEN 'BLR' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END) >= #{rank}
mapper.select: SELECT work_id, field, lang, kind, text, source, model, created FROM work_text WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY field, kind, lang

choose.otherwise: SELECT work_id, field, lang, kind, text, source, model, created FROM work_text WHERE false

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM work_text WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND field = #{field} AND kind = 'MACHINE'
mapper.update: UPDATE work w SET title_en = n.text, title_en_kind = n.kind FROM ( SELECT o.id, x.text, x.kind FROM work o LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.text, t.kind FROM work_text t WHERE t.work_id = o.id AND t.field = 'TITLE' AND t.lang = 'en' AND t.kind IN ('PARALLEL', 'MACHINE') AND coalesce(o.title_lang, o.language) IS DISTINCT FROM 'en' ORDER BY (t.kind = 'PARALLEL') DESC LIMIT 1) x ON true WHERE o.id = #{workId}) n WHERE w.id = n.id AND (w.title_en, w.title_en_kind) IS DISTINCT FROM (n.text, n.kind)
